title: Acceptance across repeated transcripts
statement: Given types $\mathrm{Domain}$ and $\mathrm{Codomain}$, natural numbers $r$ and $k$, a nonadaptive tester $T$ with $r$ query positions, a choice of seed for each of $k$ repetitions, and a transcript of $kr$ optional answers, define a Boolean that is true exactly when each repetition's seed accepts the corresponding block of $r$ transcript entries.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a nonadaptive tester with $r$ query positions
A seed of $T$ is specified for each of the $k$ repetitions
A transcript of $kr$ optional codomain values is specified
